messages:
incidents-bot: INCIDENT CREATED: Inference path latency spike detected on streaming endpoints. p95 -> 820ms, p99 -> 5.2s. Affects /v1/stream and websocket consumers. Pager duty: eng-sre on-call.

maria: I see the p95 climb starting ~14:02 UTC, sustained through last 6m. Tail sessions show repeated stalls at token generation stage.

kai: correlating with auth DB errors -> 503/timeout from token-store. Logs show auth-service retry bursts and elevated latencies.

devon: stack traces show rpc to config-fetch timing out (1000ms) leading to backpressure in request router. Might be feature-flag lookups adding extra round trips.

jess: rolling up quick metrics: streaming success rate fell from 99.7% to 96.1% in last 10m. ~1.8k requests affected, ~120 users reported elevated latency, 3 customers with higher severity (one enterprise chat bot showing repeated stalls).

maria: quick triage: is this a DB connection pool exhaustion or downstream rate limiting?

kai: DB connection queue depth shows spikes; RDS plugin metrics: connections used 92% of max, waiters rising. Also seeing auth token-store returning 429 for bursts.

devon: here's a log snippet from router (sanitized):

```
2026-03-15T14:03:10Z router[pid=87]: request_id=abc123 route=/v1/stream auth_call= -> timeout(1200ms) config_fetch=ok model=llama-2 tokengen=stalled
2026-03-15T14:03:12Z router[pid=87]: request_id=abc128 auth_call=503 retry=1 backoff=100ms
```

jess: hypothesis: new flag ff/kv-prefix-enable introduced additional config fetch path per-session; combined with auth rate bursts causing extra DB pressure -> cascading stalls.

ryan: immediate mitigations we can apply:
- disable ff/kv-prefix-enable via flag API (quick rollback)
- temporarily increase token-store DB connections and reduce app-level rate limit window to smooth bursts (rate-window=200ms)
- route streaming traffic to dedicated inference pool (if capacity exists) to reduce router queuing
- enable prefix KV cache bypass ttl to reuse existing prefix cache entries

maria: good. I'll flip the flag now and watch. Do we have the curl to do that?

devon: curl -X POST https://flags.internal/ff/kv-prefix-enable/rollback -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx' -d '{"value":false}'

maria: done. flag rollback propagated to 3 regions at 14:05:22 UTC. Monitoring...

incidents-bot: ACTION LOGGED: feature flag rollback executed by maria at 2026-03-15T14:05:22Z.

kai: initial signs good — p95 dropped from 820ms to 380ms within 30s of rollback. p99 still elevated at ~1.4s. DB waiters decreasing.

jess: I'll open a customer impact note. Affected customers: AcmeCorp (high), BeaconChat (medium), Pilot Labs (low). Notified CSMs for AcmeCorp and BeaconChat.

ryan: we should still apply a short-term DB pool increase and add a smoothing token bucket on auth service to reduce retry storms. I can patch a config change to increase max_connections by 20% for token-store read replicas.

devon: applying pool bump to token-store replicas now (deployment rolling patch). ETA ~2m.

maria: recommend we keep route fallback to dedicated pool enabled for 15m and watch traces for any regression. Also add a short-lived tracing sampling for impacted requests (10%) to collect KV/cache hits.

jess: on-call handoff plan: jess will take lead for live mitigation, devon will monitor deploys, kai will watch DB metrics, maria will handle comms. If p99 > 2s for another 5m, escalate to infra pager.

maria: status update 14:07 UTC: p95 ~320ms, p99 ~1.2s, success rate 98.6%. DB waiters dropping, token-store 429s down 95%.

jess: customer impact note posted to #support-incidents, CSMs acknowledged. Marking incident as mitigated -> moving to postmortem queue.

oncall-bot: HANDOFF: jess is now the incident lead (14:09 UTC). Next update in 15m or when state changes.

ryan: follow-up actions captured:
- root cause: flag-induced extra config fetches + auth token-store retry storms + DB connection pressure
- medium-term: add feature flag rollout guard (canary traffic threshold) and fanout limits on per-session config fetches
- infra: consider adaptive DB pool autoscaling and auth smoothing token-bucket
- ops: add a streaming-tail SLO alert threshold for DB-dep latency correlated alerts

jess: tagging postmortem owner (maria) and scheduling 1hour RCA session tomorrow. Closing live triage.

maria: thanks all. moving thread to postmortem lane. :white_check_mark:
